title: X Feed Digest
summary: Jensen Huang's Vision: NVIDIA CEO predicts AI will shift the economy from IT ($1T) to Digital Labor ($100T), making domain expertise more valuable than coding.
The AI Horse Race: Google leads in distribution (750M users), Anthropic dominates enterprise efficiency ($9B ARR on 30M users), and OpenAI wins on consumer engagement.
Crypto Flash Crash: A Hong Kong hedge fund's leveraged bet on IBIT options + Yen carry trade unwind triggered a Bitcoin flash crash to $60k.
Agentic Engineering: The industry is shifting from 'writing code' to 'managing agents' (OpenClaw, Claude Code), with Mac minis becoming the preferred home server for bots.
Walmart's Tech Pivot: Ad revenue and memberships now drive 50% of Walmart's profit growth, leading it to trade at tech-like multiples (44x P/E).

items.title: @kugo_A10: Jensen Huang's 5 AI Predictions
items.body: Jensen Huang argues that coding is dead; AI is 'digital labor' that will expand the economy 100x. The future belongs to domain experts who can command AI, not just programmers.

items.title: @aakashgupta: AI Economics & Jevons Paradox
items.body: Naval Ravikant is right: a 98% collapse in intelligence costs leads to infinite demand. The value shifts from 'providing intelligence' to 'directing intelligence' (judgment).

items.title: @gkxspace: Claude Code + Obsidian Workflow
items.body: A powerful 'vibe coding' setup: use Claude Code to write directly into Obsidian for articles, flowcharts, and layout, turning the user into a director rather than an editor.

items.title: @wquguru: OpenClaw Stability with Opus 4.5
items.body: User 'Chiti' achieved stability by switching back to Opus 4.5 for coordination. They recommend a Mac mini for reliable iMessage integration, a key for personal bots.

items.title: @ai_for_success: Kimi K2.5 as a Cheap Alternative
items.body: Kimi K2.5 is now the most used model on OpenClaw, offering 8x cheaper rates than Claude while maintaining high performance for coding and reasoning.

items.title: @KKaWSB: Anatomy of the BTC Flash Crash
items.body: Bitcoin fell to $60k due to a HK hedge fund's failed leverage play on IBIT options and a simultaneous Yen carry trade unwind.

items.title: @aakashgupta: Walmart is a Tech Company Now
items.body: Walmart trades at a 44x P/E because 50% of its profit growth comes from high-margin ad revenue and memberships, not just low-margin retail.

items.title: @ai_9684xtpa: Bithumb's 620k BTC Error
items.body: A Korean exchange accidentally airdropped 2000 BTC to every user. Most was recovered, but 125 BTC remains lost in the chaos.

items.title: @skillz17q: Trump Accounts Details
items.body: New details on the Trump Accounts program: $1,000 seed for newborns, $250 for kids 1-9. Registration via IRS form 4547 starting July 2026.

items.title: @gregisenberg: Vibe Marketing > Vibe Coding
items.body: Founders should shift focus from just building (vibe coding) to running 24/7 marketing playbooks with agents (vibe marketing) to actually get noticed.

items.title: @astro_greek: Shivon Zilis & Elon Musk

items.title: @guptar: Uber's AI Ignored Safety Risks
items.body: A jury awarded $8.5M after Uber's internal AI flagged a ride as 'High Risk' but allowed it anyway, leading to an assault. 3,000+ similar cases are pending.
